name: Ungated breakout control — range-ceiling break with NO ADX gate (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM/ROLE: the explicit ablation control for the ADX-gated breakout family. It takes the identical range_position ceiling breakout with a momentum confirm but WITHOUT the adx trend gate, so the cohort can measure the gate's incremental value directly. Economically it is the naive breakout: buy the break of the recent high whenever momentum is positive, accepting every chop-driven false break. Trend-following theory predicts this bleeds on fees because the majority of breaks fail; the gated variants should dominate it. DISCONFIRMER built into the design: if this ungated control nets the SAME (or better) than the adx-gated variants at similar CSCV-PBO/DSR, then ADX is a curve-fit free parameter in those specs and they die; if this control is materially worse, the regime gate is real. It must itself clear DSR 0.95 net of fees to count — a naive breakout that only survives via tuning is a fee-churn trap.
catalyst: range-ceiling breakout with momentum, no regime filter
